item.title: WildLanterns presented by Kaiser Permanente
item.description: WildLanterns presented by Kaiser Permanente is the season’s must-see wonderland filled with all-new, custom lantern displays. Experience an immersive adventure that promises a magical holiday moment for all!

item.title: WildLanterns: 21+ Night Owls
item.description: WildLanterns’ exclusive 21+ nights offer a unique opportunity to sip holiday-inspired cocktails, explore mesmerizing lantern displays, and discover festive themed bars throughout the zoo, all in a kid-free environment. Guests must be 21 or older and present a valid ID.

item.title: Pancakes with Penguins: Winter Waddle
item.description: Pancakes with Penguins is a breakfast experience like no other, where guests can enter the zoo early and enjoy a delightful spread of fluffy pancakes, fresh fruit, and tasty toppings— at our seasonal Skyline Pavilion and then take a stroll over to our Humboldt Penguin habitat for a keeper talk and maybe a mascot visit.
